qualityDecision: Independent frozen evaluation only; runtime success does not establish quality/adoption.

coverage.limitation: Three long documents have fragmented-sentence scope abstention and incomplete NLI coverage. All-body semantic verification must not be claimed; independent evaluation retains false negatives/abstention.

memory.method: 250ms samples of /proc browser process tree VmRSS; sum includes shared pages more than once, misses sub-interval peaks, excludes runner Node. Per-process VmHWM is lifetime, not a simultaneous unique-memory measurement.

network.credentials: Public allowlisted GET only; cookies/auth headers/body rejected, credentials omitted; HTTPS proxy preserved with local-only bypass and TLS verification enabled.

provenanceMethod.onnx: Expected byte count and SHA256 are matched against fixed official Hub LFS metadata; the browser weight byte stream is not separately digested.
provenanceMethod.wasm: Exact ORT versioned public URL is executed; binary byte digest is not measured.
provenanceMethod.jsonAndRuntime: Actual fetched JSON assets and standalone runtime script are SHA256 digested.

developmentLimit: The exact source bytes of the two public calibration runners were not snapshotted before later observability changes. Their hashes/freezes/raw results remain; this limits exact development-run reproducibility. Final heldout runner 8ad9... is preserved unchanged. Public development costs are separately recorded in public-runtime-costs.json and excluded from the heldout 15-minute ledger.
